Rules on the organisation of design contests and the selection of participants
Overview

content_blocks.text: This regulation provides that when organising design contests, contracting authorities must apply procedures which are adapted to reflect the provisions relating to design contests. Where design contests are restricted to a limited number of participants, the selection criteria must be clear and non-discriminatory and the number of candidates invited to participate must be sufficient to ensure genuine competition.
